review_summary.philosophy: Shortest, cleanest native solution with standard platform features and zero superfluous dependencies

findings.evaluation: Reused pre-existing /api/v1/services/nearby in Retrofit and URLSession APIClient. Zero new HTTP clients or endpoints invented.

Emergency helplines and canonical artisan clusters reside in static memory data structures, providing instant offline access without requiring Room schema migrations or SwiftData container alterations.
Leveraged native system dialer handoff (Intent.ACTION_DIAL and tel://) rather than inventing in-app VoIP, calling abstractions, or requesting intrusive CALL_PHONE runtime permissions.
Built with standard Jetpack Compose M3 ModalBottomSheet/Card and SwiftUI ScrollView/sheet. Zero third-party UI libraries introduced.
